name: EPCOT International Festival of the Arts 2027
summary: First pass from research. The 2027 festival (Jan 15 - Mar 1) has dates but no menus yet, so every Food Studio and dish here is the 2026 festival's, read from Disney's own 2026 Foodie Guide, with 2026 prices from WDWNT's posted menus (MickeyBlog for Gourmet Landscapes). Wonderful Walk of Colorful Cuisine dishes are labelled.
location_notes: Every booth's location is Disney's own 'Location:' line. A studio in a pavilion that also hosts a Food & Wine marketplace is pinned on that marketplace's pin at 'anchored' precision, and says so in `pinned_from`; Refreshment Outpost, Tangierine Café and Swirled Showcase are the same venues as in Food & Wine and reuse their pins.

Unplaced: studios on the walkways (Near Test Track, The Odyssey, Between Morocco and France, Near Disney Traders, Near Port of Entry, the World Showcase-Imagination! walkway), Norway's Kringla, Connections Eatery and Sunshine Seasons.

photo_pages_note: Read by `epcot-fw festival photos`, newest first. Disney rewrites one guide per festival each year; add next year's guide here when it is published and re-run: its photos replace these, dish by dish.
photo_pages_older: Checked 2023-2025 via Internet Archive copies of Disney's guides (web.archive.org): each booth had one group photo, never a photo per dish, so none can be attached to a dish. Per-dish photos start with the 2026 guide.
